metadata.phase: Revised 100-product proposal for approval; first 50 checked with explicit publication holds
metadata.scope: Research only. No website implementation, design, counts, affiliate helper or Toolkit Builder changes.

products.name: MaxiCOM MK900-BT wireless diagnostic tablet
products.purpose: Wireless all-system service-bay diagnosis
products.verificationGate: Check US region software term CAN FD and DoIP coverage
specifications: Manufacturer store states one year of updates
products.limitations: Confirm US activation, VIN-specific functions, secure-gateway fees and renewal terms for the selected seller; accessory support does not mean those accessories are included.

products.name: 5610 bidirectional OBD2 scanner
products.purpose: Handheld supported active tests and live data
products.verificationGate: Check VIN-level functions and current adapter bundle
specifications: Handheld OBD2 and supported OEM-system diagnostics
Manufacturer states free updates and no subscriptions
products.limitations: Use the manufacturer coverage checker for the exact year, make, model and function; the advertised reset list is not universal vehicle coverage.

products.name: NT301 OBDII/EOBD code reader
products.purpose: Basic emissions and engine-code investigations
products.verificationGate: Not ABS SRS coding or all-system coverage
specifications: Engine/emissions OBDII/EOBD code reading and clearing
products.limitations: An engine/emissions reader, not an all-system ABS/SRS or bidirectional tablet. Do not use the earlier search-page JSON extraction: it invented package and diesel/hybrid exclusions.

products.name: 88V/A automotive multimeter combo kit
products.purpose: Electrical diagnosis with automotive-oriented accessories
products.verificationGate: Kit identity distinct from meter-only 88V; no blanket EV high-voltage recommendation
specifications: CAT III 1000 V / CAT IV 600 V manufacturer rating
Manufacturer lists test leads, probes, clips, RPM pickup, temperature probe, magnetic hanger and case
products.limitations: Amazon identifies FLUKE-88-5/A KIT but part 892583; reconcile that package identifier with current manufacturer part 2117440 before publishing. Ratings do not establish suitability for EV high-voltage work.

products.name: Power Probe III circuit tester and lead kit
products.purpose: Power ground and circuit diagnosis on suitable vehicle circuits
products.verificationGate: Power injection can damage modules; circuit limits and training matter

products.name: SOLAR BA9 battery and system tester
products.purpose: Starting-battery and charging-system assessment
products.verificationGate: Check battery chemistry rating and supported voltage
specifications: Flooded, flat/spiral AGM and gel starting batteries
products.limitations: Requires a starting-battery rating such as CCA/CA; not a general lithium or high-voltage traction-battery tester.

products.name: Boost GB40 portable jump starter
products.purpose: Portable starting support for supported 12V applications
products.verificationGate: Engine-size and temperature claims conditional; not a charger
specifications: Manufacturer applications up to 6.0 L petrol / 3.0 L diesel
Integrated light and USB power functions
products.limitations: Match battery type and engine application. Current manufacturer imagery shows USB-C input; verify supplied revision before illustrating ports from older listing photos.

products.name: Boost lithium jump starter
products.purpose: Higher-output starting support for suitable vehicles
products.verificationGate: Not interchangeable with GB40 or GBX models

products.name: GENIUS5 smart charger and maintainer
products.purpose: Charging and maintaining compatible batteries
products.verificationGate: US AC package battery chemistry and mode restrictions
specifications: 12 V lithium charging mode for compatible batteries
products.limitations: Select the mode for the actual battery chemistry; a charger is not a jump starter. Confirm US mains version and connector bundle.

products.name: TRQ50402 1/4-inch torque wrench with case
products.purpose: Lower-torque clockwise and counterclockwise work
products.verificationGate: 10–150 in-lb; verify directional calibration
products.proposalReason: Original marked No Longer Available by manufacturer; replacement requires approval.
specifications: Manufacturer accuracy within ±3%, with serialized calibration certificate
products.limitations: Replaces discontinued TRQ21101 (10–150 in-lb); does not cover the old 10–19 in-lb range. Use a different calibrated range when a fastener requires it.

products.name: TRQ52403 1/2-inch torque wrench with case
products.purpose: Higher-range specified fastening
products.verificationGate: 25–250 ft-lb; check calibration working range
products.proposalReason: Original marked No Longer Available by manufacturer; replacement requires approval.
specifications: Manufacturer accuracy within ±3%, with serialized calibration certificate
products.limitations: Replaces discontinued 24340 (25–250 ft-lb); does not cover 25–39 ft-lb. Final tightening follows the vehicle specification, not impact-wrench settings.

products.name: 3/8-inch micrometer torque wrench
products.purpose: Intermediate service fasteners
products.verificationGate: 10–100 ft-lb; M suffix and direction matter

products.name: 1/2-inch electronic torque wrench
products.purpose: Electronic indication for supported torque settings
products.verificationGate: Do not claim torque-angle capability without documentation

products.name: 80300P 51-piece 1/4-inch mechanic socket set
products.purpose: Small fasteners and confined access
products.verificationGate: Verify 51-piece 6-point SAE/metric kit contents
products.limitations: Corrected source to 80300P; the old tracker linked to 80550P. Chrome hand-drive sockets must not be assumed impact-rated.

products.name: 3/8-inch universal metric impact socket set
products.purpose: Impact-rated access around obstructions
products.verificationGate: 15-piece N variant joint angle and size coverage

products.name: 2569 43-piece 1/2-inch metric impact socket set
products.purpose: Shallow and deep metric impact service
products.verificationGate: 43-piece kit and no-skip coverage must be checked
specifications: Includes universal joint, extensions and case
products.limitations: There are size skips: 25, 28 and 29 mm are not included. Match socket size, clearance and impact tool.

products.name: SKT15311 73-piece 3/8-inch socket and ratchet set
products.purpose: Broad hand-drive SAE/metric coverage
products.verificationGate: 73-piece configuration; verify current contents
products.limitations: Count owned tools first: kit accessories overlap separate extensions. These chrome sockets are not a substitute for the impact set.

products.name: Three-piece 90-tooth ratchet set
products.purpose: Core quarter three-eighths and half-drive coverage
products.verificationGate: T series distinct from P and XP sets

products.name: 3/8-inch stubby flex-head 120XP ratchet
products.purpose: Confined hand-driven fastening
products.verificationGate: XP generation distinct from older P model

products.name: SBH00224 24-inch breaker bar
products.purpose: Controlled manual loosening
products.verificationGate: Check load and clearance; no improvised extensions
products.limitations: Manual loosening and controlled leverage; not a calibrated torque wrench or an impact-drive accessory.

products.name: SHA91011 four-piece 3/8-inch extension set
products.purpose: Reaching recessed fasteners
products.verificationGate: Three hand-drive extensions; not impact-rated by assumption
products.proposalReason: Original marked No Longer Available by manufacturer; replacement requires approval.
specifications: Four detent grooves at drive engagement
products.limitations: Replaces discontinued three-piece SHA91005. Optional purchase if the socket kit already supplies the required reach; not advertised here as impact-rated.

products.name: Metric ratcheting combination wrench set
products.purpose: Metric hand fastening in restricted swing space
products.verificationGate: 16-piece set; compare actual sizes and head profile

products.name: SAE reversible ratcheting wrench set
products.purpose: SAE work requiring reversible ratcheting heads
products.verificationGate: Eight-piece N set not metric

products.name: 81916 22-piece metric combination wrench set
products.purpose: Broad metric coverage and manual reach
products.verificationGate: 22-piece tool-roll variant
products.limitations: Not a contiguous 6–32 mm set: 25, 26, 28, 29 and 31 mm are absent.

products.name: 81906 six-piece metric flare-nut wrench set
products.purpose: Suitable hex tube fittings and brake-line access
products.verificationGate: Six-piece set; sizes and access must match fittings
products.limitations: Listing model is 81906 but manufacturer-part metadata says Drake Off Road Tools. Resolve that provenance conflict; do not silently equate it to a fully verified GEARWRENCH offer.

products.name: 2962-20 M18 FUEL 1/2-inch mid-torque impact wrench
products.purpose: General service where access and output balance
products.verificationGate: Friction-ring bare tool; final wheel tightening requires specified torque
specifications: Manufacturer claims up to 650 ft-lb breakaway torque
products.limitations: Battery and charger are separate. Breakaway torque is a manufacturer claim, not a tightening specification. Listing has an inconsistent vendor part code; title/model/brand agree.

products.name: M12 FUEL 3/8-inch stubby impact wrench
products.purpose: Compact access with compatible M12 batteries
products.verificationGate: Newer generation; not 2554-20 or half-inch 2563-20

products.name: 2567-20 M12 FUEL 3/8-inch high-speed ratchet
products.purpose: Running accessible fasteners in suitable spaces
products.verificationGate: Powered ratchet is not an impact wrench; bare tool
products.limitations: Manufacturer page conflicts: comparison table says 37 ft-lb, feature text says 35 ft-lb. Omit a definitive maximum torque pending resolution; battery and charger separate.

products.name: 20V MAX XR 1/2-inch mid-range impact wrench
products.purpose: Mid-range work on an existing DEWALT platform
products.verificationGate: US B bare tool hog-ring variant

products.name: 20V MAX XR 1/2-inch high-torque impact wrench
products.purpose: Higher-demand compatible fastening and removal
products.verificationGate: US B bare tool; compare loaded weight and access

products.name: 25750 dual-piston brake caliper compressor
products.purpose: Supported push-back caliper piston retraction
products.verificationGate: Not a universal wind-back tool or EPB release tool
specifications: Uses the inboard pad to distribute load
products.limitations: Not a universal rear-caliper wind-back or EPB tool. Follow the vehicle retraction and reservoir procedure.

products.name: 81850 combination brake-lining thickness gauge set
products.purpose: Screening accessible pad thickness
products.verificationGate: Does not replace vehicle service limits or rotor measurement
products.limitations: Colour bands are screening aids; replacement decisions use vehicle limits and a proper inspection, not colour alone.

products.name: Disc brake piston tool
products.purpose: Supported screw-in rear caliper pistons
products.verificationGate: Verify piston slots and rotation; EPB service procedure separate

products.name: MV6840 pressure brake and clutch bleeding system
products.purpose: Pressure bleeding with matched reservoir adapters
products.verificationGate: Vehicle pressure limit and adapter seal; ABS procedures may need scan tool
specifications: Seven master-cylinder adapters in MVA6850 kit
Pressure gauge and manual relief valve
products.limitations: Match the adapter, brake fluid and vehicle pressure limit. A generic pressure bleeder does not replace a required ABS scan-tool bleeding procedure.

products.name: Pneumatic vacuum brake bleeder
products.purpose: Shop-air assisted fluid removal and bleeding
products.verificationGate: Air supply required; apparent bubbles may arise at bleeder threads

products.name: Ball joint service kit
products.purpose: Pressing supported ball joints with matching adapters
products.verificationGate: Press and adapter compatibility; not a coil-spring compressor

products.name: Front-end service set
products.purpose: Separating suitable steering linkage connections
products.verificationGate: Check puller size and joint application

products.name: Ball joint separator
products.purpose: Separating supported tapered ball joints
products.verificationGate: Jaw opening and clearance; protect threads and boots

products.name: Hub Grappler kit
products.purpose: Supported hub and bearing service
products.verificationGate: Vehicle/application chart and supplied adapters must match

products.name: Nine-way slide hammer puller set
products.purpose: Supported pulling operations using suitable attachments
products.verificationGate: Not every hub or axle supports this method

products.name: Lower control arm prying tool
products.purpose: Assisting supported control-arm positioning
products.verificationGate: Requires specified pry-bar interface; manage stored forces

products.name: A20018 three-ton aluminium floor jack
products.purpose: Portable lifting within vehicle and jack limits
products.verificationGate: Current A20018 versus older ALJ3T and A20019; minimum saddle height
specifications: 3 US ton / 6000 lb rated lifting capacity
products.limitations: Standalone Amazon result is A20019; A20018 search results include bundles. Do not publish A20019 as A20018. Lift only at approved points and support the vehicle separately.

products.name: Low-profile service jack
products.purpose: Lower-clearance lifting on suitable hard level surfaces
products.verificationGate: Exact capacity lift range and saddle interface from manual

products.name: 10498-PAIR three-ton performance jack stands
products.purpose: Flat-saddle support on compatible vehicle points
products.verificationGate: Manufacturer lists capacity per stand; distinguish single stand and kit
specifications: Two stands with rubber flat-top saddles
products.limitations: Manufacturer manual requires pair configuration for supporting a vehicle end. Do not turn the per-stand figure into an unrestricted six-ton vehicle recommendation. Match saddle and support point.

products.name: Fluid Evacuator Plus
products.purpose: Manual fluid evacuation and dispensing on supported systems
products.verificationGate: US MV7201 not EU VKN package; fluid and temperature limits

products.name: Pneumatic fluid evacuator
products.purpose: Shop-air powered extraction on compatible applications
products.verificationGate: Air supply tube access and fluid restrictions

products.name: ATF refill system
products.purpose: Filling supported sealed transmissions with matching adapters
products.verificationGate: A suffix adapter contents and vehicle fluid-level procedure

products.name: 17922 multi-drain tub
products.purpose: Collecting service fluids in a suitable container
products.verificationGate: Verify capacity splash control and disposal access
specifications: Pouring apron for draining and handling
products.limitations: Check under-vehicle clearance and expected fluid volume/temperature. Used-fluid capture and clean filling require separate containers.

products.name: 19752 six-quart oil dispenser, red spout
products.purpose: Measured handling of compatible service oil
products.verificationGate: Dedicated clean-fluid use; not an extraction pump
products.limitations: This is the red-spout 19752, not white-spout 19732 or capped 8-quart 19702. Keep clean and dedicated to compatible fluids.

products.name: Catch-All drip pan
products.purpose: Containing incidental service drips
products.verificationGate: Not a substitute for a sufficiently sized drain container

products.name: 63600 spin-on oil-filter removal wrench
products.purpose: Removing supported spin-on filters in confined spaces
products.verificationGate: Check filter diameter and direction; not universal cartridge-cap fit
products.limitations: Not for installing or tightening a filter. Match diameter and access; cartridge caps need a different tool.

products.name: Wide-range filter wrench
products.purpose: Broader supported spin-on filter removal
products.verificationGate: Access and diameter range must match

products.name: Toyota Lexus Scion cartridge filter wrench
products.purpose: Supported Toyota-family cartridge caps
products.verificationGate: Exact engine/cap fit; current design differs from older tools

products.name: BMW cartridge filter wrench
products.purpose: Supported BMW filter-cap geometry
products.verificationGate: 86.4mm fit and exact cap application; not generic BMW compatibility

products.name: 13270 seven-piece low-profile filter socket set
products.purpose: Servicing several supported filter-canister hex sizes
products.verificationGate: Confirm seven-piece kit and exact socket list
products.limitations: Match exact cap geometry and engine. A size list alone is not universal filter compatibility.

products.name: Nineteen-piece Spill-Free funnel kit
products.purpose: Filling compatible cooling systems with matched adapters
products.verificationGate: Newer kit; distinguish older 24680 and heavy-duty 24990

products.name: Cooling-system pressure test kit
products.purpose: Pressure-testing supported cooling systems and caps
products.verificationGate: Older application chart requires current vehicle fit confirmation

products.name: AirEvac cooling-system refill kit
products.purpose: Vacuum evacuation and refill where supported
products.verificationGate: Shop-air requirement sealing and adapter fit

products.name: Cooling-system pressure tester
products.purpose: Testing supported cooling-system pressures
products.verificationGate: Exact included adapters current service status and vehicle limits

products.name: Heater-core backflush tool
products.purpose: Controlled flushing on compatible hose connections
products.verificationGate: Vehicle restrictions and coolant capture; not chemical-proof by assumption

products.name: 3018 digital tyre inflator with hose
products.purpose: Shop-air inflation with digital pressure indication
products.verificationGate: 3018 versus green 3018GR; resolution is not accuracy
specifications: Manufacturer accuracy table: ±1.2 psi at 0–58 psi; ±2.0 psi at 59–174 psi
products.limitations: Resolution is not accuracy. Needs an appropriate compressed-air supply; follow the vehicle pressure specification and the inflator manual.

products.name: Dual-head chuck tire inflator gauge
products.purpose: Shop-air inflation with mechanical indication
products.verificationGate: Original S-506 versus updated S-506D; exact hose and range

products.name: S-921 passenger-car pencil tyre-pressure gauge
products.purpose: Compact manual tire-pressure checking
products.verificationGate: 5–50 PSI range; distinguish S-921AG and pack quantity
products.limitations: Not a high-pressure truck gauge; check the required cold pressure lies inside its range. Manufacturer material description takes precedence over inconsistent retailer fields.

products.name: MaxiTPMS diagnostic and relearn tool
products.purpose: Supported TPMS activation relearn and MX-sensor programming
products.verificationGate: US coverage WiFi model and tool-only versus sensor kit

products.name: Valve core torque tool
products.purpose: Specified valve-core installation and removal
products.verificationGate: Exact valve and torque requirement; not a wheel torque wrench

products.name: Compression tester kit
products.purpose: Supported engine cylinder compression tests
products.verificationGate: Gasoline adapter coverage; not 5606-DG or diesel high-pressure testing

products.name: Cylinder leakage tester kit
products.purpose: Comparing cylinder leakage on supported engines
products.verificationGate: Requires compressed air and correct engine positioning

products.name: Vacuum and low-pressure gauge kit
products.purpose: Suitable intake-vacuum and low-pressure checks
products.verificationGate: Not direct-injection fuel-rail or common-rail diesel testing

products.name: Fuel pressure tester kit
products.purpose: Supported low-pressure fuel-injection diagnosis
products.verificationGate: Never infer direct-injection high-pressure compatibility

products.name: Harmonic damper pulley puller
products.purpose: Pulling specifically supported damper pulleys
products.verificationGate: Application-specific jaws rods and updated fitment

products.name: 66118 Stylus Pro penlight, black

products.verificationGate: Reuse existing shared record; retain exact black variant

products.name: Yellow Dualie 3AA with alkaline batteries
products.purpose: Supported spot and flood inspection lighting
products.verificationGate: Yellow battery-included package; hazardous-location conditions are specific

products.name: 2125-20 M12 underhood light, bare tool
products.purpose: Illuminating an engine bay on compatible mounting geometry
products.verificationGate: Bare tool battery extra; mounting span and hood clearance
products.limitations: Candidate B0CDVFR3V7 has P.T.S. brand metadata. Alternate B06ZZYPCNL detail request failed unresolved (request 78b12c1e-cd4c-4501-a0b9-2969978bda11). Exact brand/package remains on hold; battery/charger separate.

products.name: 12V Max connected inspection camera
products.purpose: Visual access where probe diameter and geometry fit
products.verificationGate: US battery/charger package probe size bend and fluids limits

products.name: 83151 20-inch three-drawer steel toolbox
products.purpose: Organized portable hand-tool storage
products.verificationGate: Loaded carrying weight drawer dimensions and retention
products.limitations: Portable storage rather than a complete workshop cabinet; account for loaded carrying weight.

products.name: Forty-two-inch eleven-drawer mobile workstation
products.purpose: Fixed-shop storage and movable work station
products.verificationGate: Freight package load ratings and shop footprint

products.verificationGate: Exact red XTR model versus older 8057 and decorated variants

products.name: Adjustable work table with drawer
products.purpose: Positioning selected tools or parts by the job
products.verificationGate: B suffix load height and stability; not a vehicle support

products.name: Heavy-duty portable rolling tool case
products.purpose: Mobile service tool transport
products.verificationGate: Empty case versus bundled tool kit and actual carrying limits

products.name: DPG94-1C Dominator safety glasses, clear lens
products.purpose: Suitable impact-rated eye protection where risk assessment permits

specifications: Manufacturer variant DPG94-1C is clear lens

products.name: X4A PELTOR over-head hearing protectors
products.purpose: Hearing protection selected for measured workshop noise
products.verificationGate: US NRR versus non-US SNR; single unit versus ten-unit case
specifications: US manufacturer technical sheet NRR 27 dB
products.limitations: US NRR is not overseas SNR/SLC80. Both candidate ASINs return an inconsistent internal ASIN; exact single-unit headband listing remains on hold. Attenuation depends on fit and exposure assessment.

products.name: Rechargeable multipurpose extinguisher
products.purpose: Workshop fire-equipment planning subject to local requirements
products.verificationGate: Exact current model rating recall check mounting and trained use

products.name: 70472 rubber wheel chocks, two-pack
products.purpose: Resisting movement in a correctly planned support setup
products.verificationGate: Tire size surface load and direction; not a substitute for stands
products.limitations: No verified load/grade limit was found in the source. Do not invent one or claim universal suitability; these are not jack stands.

products.name: 80066H 20-piece mechanic screwdriver set
products.verificationGate: New mechanic-specific fixed-blade coverage
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
products.limitations: Exact H suffix matters. Includes small precision profiles and T15/T20, not a complete Torx fastener range. Choose an appropriate profile and avoid using screwdrivers as pry bars.

products.name: D203-8 eight-inch needle-nose side-cutting pliers
products.verificationGate: Reuse klein-d203-8
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
products.limitations: Reuse existing klein-d203-8. Standard model is not the insulated -INS or glow-handle -GLW variant; handle covering is not electrical insulation.

products.name: D228-8 eight-inch diagonal-cutting pliers
products.verificationGate: Reuse klein-d228-8
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
specifications: Short jaws and bevelled cutting edges
products.limitations: Reuse existing klein-d228-8. Standard version, not -INS or tethered -TT. Intended for cutting appropriate material, not hardened automotive fasteners.

products.name: 502L3 Original 10WR curved-jaw locking pliers
products.verificationGate: Exact 10WR standard-release single tool
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
products.limitations: Not the 4935576 alternate or a five-pack. Locking jaws can damage finished fittings; use the proper fitting wrench where required.

products.name: 87 01 250 ten-inch Cobra water-pump pliers
products.verificationGate: Reuse knipex-8701250
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
products.limitations: Reuse existing knipex-8701250. Serrated jaws suit gripping tasks, not every precision line fitting. Do not substitute other handle/insulation variants.

products.name: 80742 84-piece hex/Torx bit socket set
products.verificationGate: Verify exact profiles and sizes; hand-driven
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
specifications: Torx, tamper-resistant Torx and external Torx
products.limitations: Manufacturer explicitly limits use to manual drive tools: do not put these on the cordless impact wrench. Match individual sizes to the course and serviced vehicles.

products.name: 80601 five-piece magnetic swivel spark-plug socket set
products.verificationGate: Verify sizes especially 14mm versus 9/16; do not assume all engines fit
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
products.limitations: Does not cover 13/16-inch or 14 mm school/vehicle needs. 9/16 inch is not an exact 14 mm substitute. Do not claim a complete ignition-service kit.

products.name: 68100 deluxe feeler gauge
products.verificationGate: Range and blade count from manufacturer not 68150 reseller metadata
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
products.limitations: Not 68150 go/no-go. The Chemeketa list extends to 0.040 inch, so this set alone does not meet that entire range. Follow the required vehicle measuring procedure.

products.name: 61366 Dominator five-piece curved pry-bar set
products.verificationGate: Purpose-made handled bars; existing Stanley flat demolition bar is not equivalent
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
products.limitations: Manufacturer catalogue index identifies 61366, but full PDF fetch is blocked. Exact individual lengths and current pack revision remain unconfirmed; do not copy conflicting retailer dimensions. A flat carpenter demolition bar is not equivalent.

products.name: 31750 four-piece mini hook-and-pick set
products.verificationGate: Small seal clip and O-ring access with damage limitations
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
products.limitations: Useful for clips, seals and O-rings with care; sharp picks can score sealing surfaces. Not a heavy pry-bar substitute.

products.name: 35440 three-piece body-trim tool set
products.verificationGate: Obtain exact product source before publication
products.purpose: Fills a documented apprentice coverage gap; confirm actual school and employer requirements.
specifications: Bent handles and stepped fastener cut-outs
products.limitations: A metal fastener/clip set, not an all-plastic no-mar trim-pry kit. Match clip design and protect visible surfaces.

products.name: HT-2 telescoping magnetic pickup tool

products.name: 33-725 FATMAX Classic 25-foot tape measure

Phillips, slotted, square and T25 profiles

products.name: Bluetooth Pro OBDII scan tool
